nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Bạn bè · bài tự soạn
kind: 10 câu hỏi – đáp với bạn bè
L: Long time no see! How have you been?
Pretty good, thanks. Busy with school.
Do you want to hang out this weekend?
Sure, what did you have in mind?
Sorry, come again? It's really noisy here.
I said, let's go somewhere quieter.
Why didn't you reply to my message?
Can I borrow your charger for a sec?
Guess what? I passed my driving test!
Are you still mad at me?
Pretty much everyone from our class.
Do you mind if I bring a friend?
Not at all, the more the merrier.

exq.q: Long time no see! How have you been?
exq.a: Pretty good, thanks. Busy with school.
exq.why: How have you been? hỏi dạo này thế nào → kể tình hình: Pretty good…

exq.q: Sorry, come again? It's really noisy here.
exq.a: I said, let's go somewhere quieter.
exq.why: Sorry, come again? = nhờ nói lại → nhắc lại câu: I said, …

exq.q: Guess what? I passed my driving test!
exq.why: Bạn báo tin vui → phản ứng ngạc nhiên + chúc mừng.

exq.q: Do you mind if I bring a friend?
exq.a: Not at all, the more the merrier.
exq.why: Do you mind if …? → Not at all = không phiền (đồng ý).

w: The bill is on the table.
exq.why: Shall we …? = rủ → Sounds fair = đồng ý.
